# Family Kitchen Da Nang

> Vietnamese cooking class hosted by a Franco-Vietnamese couple of chefs in their home in Sơn Trà, Da Nang, near My Khe Beach. $35 per person, including a local market visit and a shared meal of the dishes you cook. Vegan options available. Book on WhatsApp.

Classes run every day at 9:30 AM, 1:00 PM and 4:30 PM (about 3 hours), for 1 to 8 people. Address: 42 Lê Hữu Trác, An Hải, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng. Contact: WhatsApp +84 947 895 066 or familykitchendanang@gmail.com.

## Classes

- [Cooking class programme](https://familykitchendanang.com/#programme): Market visit, the 6 Vietnamese dishes you cook, schedule and what's included
- [Photo gallery](https://familykitchendanang.com/#gallery): Photos of the dishes and guests cooking during the class
- [Guest reviews](https://familykitchendanang.com/#testimonials): Reviews from past guests, rated 5/5 on Google
- [FAQ](https://familykitchendanang.com/faq.html): Answers about price, duration, dietary options, location and booking

## Book

- [Book on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/84947895066): Fastest way to book a class or ask a question
- [Booking form](https://familykitchendanang.com/#contact): Request a date, session and group size online
